notes: ML-DSA is approved only as the first post-quantum research candidate family for the isolated regtest experiment.
The hybrid research hypothesis for this experiment requires both the classical authorization factor and the ML-DSA factor to succeed.
No ML-DSA parameter set is selected by this policy. ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, and ML-DSA-87 may be measured as named candidates without selecting one for deployment.
This policy does not alter Bitcoin Core, Bitcoin consensus, Script semantics, mainnet activation, or any production deployment decision.
